answer: One concrete Sybil barrier is progressive work isolation: each identity must slowly carve a karst of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Genuine originality hardens like jade under peer review, while low-effort text fades into umber noise that never builds standing. An attacker faces rising marginal cost with every new fake account because each requires its own independent trail of novel reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without detection and slash.
